title: IBPS RRB 2026 Exam Calendar OUT - PO Prelims Nov 21–22, Clerk Prelims Dec 6–13, Notification June–July
author: Ash K.
summary: IBPS has released the official exam calendar for IBPS RRB 2026 (CRP RRBs XV). PO (Officer Scale-I) Prelims on November 21–22, 2026. Clerk (Office Assistant) Prelims on December 6, 12–13, 2026. Detailed notification with vacancies expected June–July 2026. Last year had 13,316+ vacancies across 28 Regional Rural Banks. Apply at ibps.in once notification releases.
body: The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has officially released the exam dates for IBPS RRB 2026 (CRP RRBs XV) - the annual recruitment drive for Officer Scale-I, II, III and Office Assistant (Multipurpose/Clerk) posts across 28 Regional Rural Banks in India. The detailed notification with vacancies is expected June–July 2026 at ibps.in. This is one of the biggest banking recruitment drives of the year - last cycle had over 13,316 vacancies.

Posts and eligibility overview: Office Assistant (Multipurpose/Clerk) - Graduates aged 18–28 years, with proficiency in the local language of the state. Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager/PO) - Graduates aged 18–30 years. Officer Scale-II - Graduates with 2 years banking experience, aged up to 32 years. Officer Scale-III - Graduates with 5 years banking experience, aged up to 40 years. All candidates must have basic computer knowledge. Local language proficiency is mandatory - check the specific RRB's state requirement.

What makes IBPS RRB different from IBPS PO/Clerk? IBPS RRB recruits for Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) - government-owned rural development banks co-sponsored by the central government, state governments, and NABARD. RRBs operate under the RBI framework. The salary is lower than PSU banks (SBI, PNB etc.) but the competition is significantly less intense. Posting is typically local/state-level, which suits candidates wanting to serve in their home state. No interview for Office Assistant; interview is required for Officers.

Exam pattern - Officer Scale-I Prelims: 80 questions, 80 marks, 45 minutes. Sections: Reasoning (40 Qs) and Quantitative Aptitude (40 Qs). Qualifying in nature - Mains marks decide merit. Office Assistant Prelims: 80 questions, 80 marks, 45 minutes. Sections: Reasoning (40 Qs) and Numerical Ability (40 Qs). Negative marking: 0.25 marks per wrong answer in Prelims.

Start preparation now: With the notification 1–2 months away and Prelims in November–December, candidates have 5–6 months to prepare. Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, English/Hindi Language, General Awareness (Banking), and Computer Knowledge are the core subjects. Candidates often simultaneously prepare for IBPS PO and IBPS RRB PO since syllabus overlap is high. See our SBI PO exam guide for overlapping preparation strategy, or check the RBI Grade B guide for a premium banking career route.

faqs.question: When is IBPS RRB 2026 notification releasing?
faqs.answer: The IBPS RRB 2026 (CRP RRBs XV) detailed notification with vacancies and application link is expected in June–July 2026 at ibps.in. The exam calendar with dates has already been announced officially.

faqs.question: When is IBPS RRB PO Prelims 2026?
faqs.answer: IBPS RRB Officer Scale-I (PO) Prelims 2026 is scheduled for November 21–22, 2026. Mains will be held on December 20, 2026.

faqs.question: When is IBPS RRB Clerk Prelims 2026?
faqs.answer: IBPS RRB Office Assistant (Clerk) Prelims 2026 is scheduled for December 6, 12, and 13, 2026. Mains will be held on January 30, 2027.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are expected in IBPS RRB 2026?
faqs.answer: Based on the previous cycle (CRP RRBs XIV), which had 13,316 vacancies, IBPS RRB 2026 is expected to have 13,000–15,000 vacancies across Officer Scale-I, II, III and Office Assistant posts in 28 Regional Rural Banks. Exact vacancies will be announced with the notification.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for IBPS RRB 2026?
faqs.answer: For Office Assistant: Graduate degree, age 18–28 years, local language proficiency. For Officer Scale-I: Graduate degree, age 18–30 years. Both require basic computer knowledge. Proficiency in the official language of the state of the RRB applied to is mandatory.

faqs.question: What is the difference between IBPS RRB PO and IBPS PO?
faqs.answer: IBPS RRB PO recruits for Regional Rural Banks (rural-focused, state-level posting, lower salary, less competition). IBPS PO recruits for nationalised public sector banks (urban/semi-urban postings, higher salary, higher competition). Syllabus overlap is high, making simultaneous preparation efficient.

callout.heading: Notification in 4–6 Weeks - Start Prep Now
callout.content: IBPS RRB 2026 notification drops June–July. Prelims are November–December. That's 5–6 months of prep time if you start today. Quant, Reasoning, and Banking GK are the core - same topics as IBPS PO. Candidates preparing for both simultaneously maximise their chances.
